payload.title: Vehicle Camera Driving FX (주행 카메라 연출 고도화)
payload.next_action: Freeze the Camera FX contract and data ownership before implementation: define the exact VehicleData authored ReferenceMaxSpeed field/validation/migration; normalized planar speed and longitudinal/lateral rate math with spawn/teleport/delta-time fail-safe; Gameplay View versus Presentation View runtime API and TargetSelect/Aim consumers; optional per-VehicleData CameraData/profile override with component fallback; effect curves, absolute output clamps, interpolation, Combat/Aim/Airborne/Reverse attenuation and composition order. Start implementation only after P0 and blocking P1 are exact0.

provenance.resolution_basis: VCFX-P0-00 fresh rebaseline and pre-implementation design review completed with P0 0 / blocking P1 0 / P2 1 non-blocking / TECHNICAL DESIGN PASS. Current camera speed uses 3D velocity magnitude normalized by a global SpeedForMaxBonusKmh; VehicleData owns physical cause parameters but no authored runtime top-speed reference; Vehicle Builder benchmark provides PeakSpeedKmh and related performance evidence. The accepted design direction is per-VehicleData authored ReferenceMaxSpeed exact1 as the common normalization denominator for planar speed and longitudinal/lateral velocity-change rates, with no silent global fallback. TargetSelect consumes actual camera origin/direction/up/FOV, so Gameplay View and Presentation View must be separated before driving FOV/roll/shake implementation. Fresh persisted AssetDump dataset: adset_v1_5acb83e891e1f4b9ef2d733afbb71be4.bdd1b15768494d24cc66139c. Source/Product Asset mutation 0; Build/Automation/PIE not run for this design-only gate.
